entries.prompt:
Create a production 2D game sprite sheet on truly transparent alpha. Wide landscape exact 3 columns by 2 rows, six independent components, margins around EVERY slot and around all external edges, centered inside each of six equal cells. No contact across cells, no grid, no UI, no letters, no surface, no exterior shadow. All assets are softly hand-painted, polished, deep and dimensional cozy fantasy game illustrations, miniature product rendering with rich natural subtle texture, warm soft upper-left lighting, fine edge highlights and strong tiny-scale silhouettes. Make the components easily separable in this exact arrangement:
TOP LEFT: front-on circular or themed fishing reel HOUSING ONLY, center axle perfectly in the middle of the cell, dark recessed empty center with no visible flower or crank, occupies 72 percent of cell width.
TOP CENTER: front-on ROTATING REEL FACE only, isolated compact round decorative solid disc including a tiny crank handle inside its perimeter where suitable. Exact axle in center of cell, occupies 55 percent of cell width. No outer housing.
TOP RIGHT: fishing FLOAT bobber only, solid silhouette facing forward and small clearly visible eyelet at the top, occupies 50 percent of cell width. No water or line.
BOTTOM LEFT: the slim straight fishing rod GRIP only, exactly VERTICAL, symmetrical centered shape, fully visible with decorative collar and material detail, no reel attached, height 72 percent of cell.
BOTTOM CENTER: standalone long thin polished rod SHAFT STRIP ONLY, exactly HORIZONTAL tip to the RIGHT, uniform orientation, isolated on alpha, visible material, finely painted gradient and tight decorative bands, width 76 percent of cell and height 8 percent of cell, no hooks or accessories.
BOTTOM RIGHT: complete single matched fishing rod inventory icon in compact bottom-left to top-right diagonal composition, with same reel near the handle and with the matching bobber beside the rod. Must fit complete in its own cell with ample margins. No labels or UI.
Specific design for all six pieces: Cherry blossom love letters at a rosy harbor. Dark dried-rose lacquer with thin champagne-gold ferrules, ivory handle with a tiny dusty blue engraved scallop shell near the butt, aged delicately beveled champagne-brass frame, asymmetric burgundy pink WAX SEAL rotating face with shallow pressed five-petal cherry blossom in the wax and subtle semi-matte wax patina. The float is a snug warm cream envelope with a deep rose seal and dark rose edges, no red dot elsewhere.
